## Supplementary pointers {.unnumbered}

These aren't formal citations but are useful entry points if you want to
chase the lineage of the analysis or the surrounding literature.

- **The methodology reference doc** for this project, which informed
  preprocessing choices and figure-roster decisions, lives in the Castro
  Lab Obsidian vault under
  `Odormapping/Resources/PLS Analysis Best Practices for Paired Neural Population Data.md`.
- **The Wachowiak/Burton handoff email** establishing the two null models
  (multiplicative gain and random retuning) is summarised in
  `Odormapping/Resources/resource-071.md`.
- **Sibling repos.** `~/code/glom-explorer` carries the clustering,
  tuning, topography, and bundled data utilities; `~/code/pls-explorer`
  (this analysis) is sibling to it and will eventually fold back in as
  `glom_explorer/pls/`.
- **The original messy notebooks** that preceded the clean rewrite live
  at `~/code/castro-lab-codebase/notebooks/modeling/PLS_play{1,2,3}.ipynb`.
